# mcp-grafana sidecar — TI-1417

Connects OpenFang to the Liftit Grafana instance (`https://observability.liftit.co`)
using the **official** `grafana/mcp-grafana` image. No custom build.

## Why this matters

Grafana sits on top of our curated datasources (Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus,
Loki, CloudWatch, etc.) and curated dashboards. Exposing Grafana to the agent
lets it reuse queries that our team already validated, instead of reinventing
PromQL/MQL from scratch for each question.

50 tools registered on OpenFang as `mcp_grafana_*` — search dashboards, extract
panel queries, query any datasource, list alert rules, check OnCall schedules.

## Architecture

```
OpenFang ──HTTP──► mcp-grafana:8000/mcp ──HTTPS──► observability.liftit.co
                    (grafana/mcp-grafana)           (Grafana + datasources)
```

- Container runs the official image in `streamable-http` mode on port 8000.
- Docker network internal only — no host port published.
- Auth: Grafana service account token (`glsa_*`) injected via
  `GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN` env var.

## Service account setup (one-time)

1. Log in to https://observability.liftit.co with an admin account.
2. Go to **Administration → Users and access → Service accounts**.
3. Create account `openfang-hand-mcp-prod`, role **Viewer** (no higher).
4. Under **Tokens**, add a token `openfang-mcp-v1`. Copy the `glsa_...` value
   immediately — Grafana does not show it again.
5. On the openfang VM, append the token to `/opt/openfang/.env`:
   ```
   GRAFANA_TOKEN=glsa_xxxxxxxxxxxx
   ```
6. Restart: `cd /opt/openfang && sudo docker compose up -d mcp-grafana --force-recreate`.

The token identity in Grafana logs is `sa-1-openfang-hand-mcp-prod`.

## Deploy

The sidecar is configured in `/opt/openfang/docker-compose.override.yml`
(auto-generated by the openfang deploy scripts). The snippet in
`docker-compose-snippet.yml` shows the exact service block.

## OpenFang registration

In `/opt/openfang/config.toml`:

```toml
[[mcp_servers]]
name = "grafana"
transport = { type = "http", url = "http://mcp-grafana:8000/mcp" }
```

After adding, restart openfang and look for:

```
MCP server connected server=grafana tools=50
```

## Smoke test

```bash
docker run --rm --network openfang_default curlimages/curl:latest \
  -sS -X POST http://mcp-grafana:8000/mcp \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"smoke","version":"0.1"}}}'
```

Expect a JSON-RPC response listing server capabilities and tool categories
(dashboards, datasources, prometheus, loki, alerting, etc.).

Note: `tools/list` requires a session id from the initialize response. For
interactive testing use the OpenFang side (easier).

## Token rotation

- Default cadence: 90 days (Grafana default max) or whenever the token is
  potentially exposed (logs, tickets, screenshots).
- Generate a new token in the same service account.
- Update `/opt/openfang/.env`.
- Restart `mcp-grafana` container.
- Revoke the old token in Grafana.

## Troubleshooting

- **`Invalid session ID`** on manual curl: expected. Streamable HTTP requires
  the `Mcp-Session-Id` header returned by initialize; plain curl without
  session state will see this for any non-initialize call.
- **Container restarts on loop**: `sudo docker logs openfang-mcp-grafana`
  usually shows token-related errors (invalid prefix, expired, revoked).
- **OpenFang fails to register**: check `config.toml` uses `transport = {...}`
  inline-table syntax, not `[mcp_servers.grafana.transport]` sub-table.
- **Grafana returns 403 on specific tools**: the service account is Viewer.
  Some tools (admin, incident mutation) need Editor/Admin — out of scope for
  v1, the DoD explicitly requires non-admin scope.

## Upstream

- Source: https://github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana
- Image: `docker.io/grafana/mcp-grafana` (current digest pinned in compose by
  tag `latest` — consider pinning to a semver tag once Grafana publishes one).

feat(apps/ai): TI-1417 MCP Grafana sidecar deployed

Adds the official grafana/mcp-grafana container to the openfang stack,
pointing at https://observability.liftit.co. Streamable HTTP transport on
port 8000, endpoint /mcp. OpenFang registers 50 tools as mcp_grafana_*.

scoped al agente (no admin)".

Value unlock: the agent can now reuse validated Grafana panel queries and
alert rules instead of inventing PromQL/MQL on demand. Supersedes most of
the utility of the Cloud Monitoring MCP (TI-1416) since Grafana already
exposes Cloud Monitoring as a datasource via sec/grafana-config v1.1.
